chapters.name: Unit 1 Population Demography
topics: National Population Policy 2000 — objectives, target year 2045
Birth rate, death rate, sex ratio, literacy rate

chapters.name: Unit 2 Caste And Class
topics: Caste (Jati) — definition, characteristics (birth-based, endogamy, hierarchical, occupation)
Class — open system, based on merit/qualification
OBC — Other Backward Classes — Mandal Commission

topics: Joint family (Sanyukt Parivaar) — characteristics, Karta, merits
Nuclear/single family vs joint family — 4 differences

topics: Tribes in India — distribution, language-based classification (4 categories)
State with highest tribal population — Madhya Pradesh
Tribal movements — Chipko (1973), Bondo, Mizo, Narmada Bachao Andolan

chapters.name: Unit 5 Social Stratification Movements

important_sociologists_and_concepts.M_N_Srinivas: Sanskritization concept + Dominant Caste concept — NCERT mein bahut important
important_sociologists_and_concepts.Raja_Rammohan_Roy: Father of Indian nationalism + Brahmo Samaj 1828 + Sati Pratha abolished
important_sociologists_and_concepts.Jyotiba_Phule: Satyashodhak Samaj + Social reform movement + OBC upliftment
important_sociologists_and_concepts.B_R_Ambedkar: Dalit movement + Indian Constitution architect + anti-untouchability
important_sociologists_and_concepts.Swami_Dayanand_Saraswati: Arya Samaj — NOT Vivekananda (common exam trap)
important_sociologists_and_concepts.Louis_Wirth: Urbanism as a 'special way of life'
important_sociologists_and_concepts.E_F_Bargel: Urbanization = process converting rural to urban areas

important_years_chronological.1828: Brahmo Samaj founded — Raja Rammohan Roy
important_years_chronological.1992: 73rd and 74th Constitutional Amendments — Panchayati Raj + Municipalities
important_years_chronological.2005: RTI Act + Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act

common_true_false_traps_to_memorize.Arya_Samaj_Vivekananda: ASATYA — Swami Dayanand Saraswati ne banaya (Vivekananda = Ramakrishna Mission)
common_true_false_traps_to_memorize.Sarpanch_indirect_election: ASATYA — Sarpanch DIRECT voting se chuna jaata hai
common_true_false_traps_to_memorize.Dominant_caste_equals_upper_caste: ASATYA — dominant caste = numerical majority + land; upper caste alag concept
common_true_false_traps_to_memorize.Death_rate_more_than_birth_India: ASATYA — birth rate > death rate India mein (growth positive hai)
common_true_false_traps_to_memorize.Industrial_society_handicraft: ASATYA — industrial society mein MACHINE production; handicraft = pre-industrial
common_true_false_traps_to_memorize.Social_movement_no_dissent: ASATYA — dissent and opposition are part of social movements
common_true_false_traps_to_memorize.Mixed_economy_India_false: SATYA — India mein mixed economy hai (correct!)
common_true_false_traps_to_memorize.Namami_Gange_wrong_program: SATYA — Namami Gange = Ganga pollution prevention program

match_column_all_pairs_consolidated.Soap_opera: Musical episodes of serial (Dharavahik ki sangeetpurn kadiyan)
match_column_all_pairs_consolidated.Disinvestment: Withdrawal of government capital from public industries

one_sentence_master_list.Replacement_level: Pratisthapan star woh demographic sthiti hai jahan TFR approximately 2.1 ho aur janasankhya stable rahe
one_sentence_master_list.Dominant_caste: M.N. Srinivas ke anusar woh jati jo sankhya, bhoomi aur rajneetic shakti mein sarvopari ho
one_sentence_master_list.Sanskritization: M.N. Srinivas ki avdharna — nimn jaatiyan ucch/prabhu jaatiyon ke ritirivaaj apnati hain apni sthiti uunchha karne ke liye
one_sentence_master_list.Urbanization: E.F. Bargel ke anusar gramin kshetron ka nagari kshetron mein badalne ki prakriya ko nageekaran kehte hain
one_sentence_master_list.Liberalization: 1991 mein shuru — sarkar dwara arthik niyantran hatana, videshi poonji ko protsahan dena
one_sentence_master_list.Globalization: Vashveekaran — vishwa ke deshon ke beech arthik, samajik aur saanskritik aadhaan-pradan ki prakriya
one_sentence_master_list.Disinvestment: Sarkar ka sarkari udyogon ki shares bazaar mein bechhna — paisa prapt karna
one_sentence_master_list.Green_Revolution: Harit Kranti — 1960s mein uchh-urja beej, khad, sinchai se krishi utpaadan mein bhari vriddhi
one_sentence_master_list.Emergency_India: 1975 mein Indira Gandhi sarkar ne 25 June ko Article 352 ke tahat Rashtriya Aapatkaal ghoshit kiya

most_scoring_sections: Easy — agar facts yaad hain toh 28-32 marks confirm
Easy to Medium — definitions aur short points

tips: Q1-Q5 ke sab 32 questions attempt karo — no negative marking
Q6-Q23 mein OR option hai — pehle dono padhkar aasaan wala choose karo
Long answers (Q20-Q23) = 16 marks total — Sociology mein History se zyada! Bahut important.
T/F mein 3 sabse common traps: Arya Samaj = Vivekananda (ASATYA), Sarpanch = indirect election (ASATYA), Death rate > birth rate India mein (ASATYA)
Match column mein — Hindu Marriage Act = 1955, Sati = Raja Rammohan Roy, Chipko = Goura Devi, McLuhan = Global Village — baar baar aata hai
Arya Samaj = Dayanand Saraswati aur Brahmo Samaj = Raja Rammohan Roy — dono alag hain, mix mat karo
73rd Amendment = Panchayati Raj; 74th Amendment = Municipalities — dono alag hain
1991 = Liberalization; 1976 = First NPP; 1999 = National Policy for Elderly; 2005 = RTI Act — years pakke karo
VSA mein sirf 30 words limit — seedhe 1-2 points likhna kaafi hai, zyada likhne ki zarurat nahi
Long answer mein intro + 4 numbered points + short conclusion — table format for comparisons useful hai
Sociologists aur unke concepts yaad karo: Srinivas = Sanskritization + Dominant Caste; McLuhan = Global Village; Louis Wirth = Urbanism as special way of life

time_allocation.note: 32 marks. 30 minutes. No negative marking — sab attempt karo. Ek bhi blank mat chhoda.
10 questions x 2 = 20 marks. Har question 4 minutes. 30 words mein seedha definition ya 2 points.
4 questions x 3 = 12 marks. Har question 8-9 minutes. 3 numbered points.
4 questions x 4 = 16 marks. Har question 10 minutes. Intro + 4 points + conclusion.
Spellings check karo — Sanskritization, Urbanization, Panchayati Raj, Liberalization, Globalization.

targets.strategy: Q1-Q5 objective mein 25+ marks aasaan. 2-3 VSA attempt karo. Total 30+ marks comfortably.
focus_areas: Objective Q1-Q5 sab attempt karo — no negative marking
Caste + demography facts — easy MCQ/Fill blank
Brahmo Samaj, Sati Pratha, Raja Rammohan Roy, Liberalization 1991 — clearly pata ho
Match column pairs yaad karo — full 7 marks aasaan
Social movements — Chipko, Narmada, Dalit, Women
Match column + One sentence full marks
NPP 2000 Long answer — easy and repeated

targets.strategy: Objective sab (32) + VSA sab (20) + Short sab (12) + Long 2-3 (8-12) = 72-76.
focus_areas: Long answers (Q20-Q23) = 16 marks — sabse important section
Sociology mein 4 long answers hain — Economy, Social Movements, Colonialism, Population — sab prepare karo
T/F traps avoid karo (Arya Samaj, Sarpanch, death rate)
All match column pairs pakke karo
